records.name: Vin Untrace
records.biography_en: Vin Untrace works the Removal Detail with The Unremarkable Finish. When a player leaves another HyperNorm block in pieces, the crew returns with familiar tools and a fresh estimate. Vin Untrace takes pride in leaving one small part of the district easier to live in.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Vin Untrace has seen this corner before. The building was facing another direction then.
